findings.description: Same id then pwd sequence: each attack fetches once (3,5), both overwrite the same base|* entry, and the first victim after each overwrite refetches while later victims are served from the overwritten entry. Attack-chosen command choice is therefore a property of the poisoned entry, not of the level-5 build only.
findings.title: afdc173f: attacker-chosen command overwrites the wildcard entry identically

limitations: All RCE in this corpus is RCE on the upstream host
